abilities._comment: Was a plain STATIC, which nothing dispatches -- the ability never ran. The condition counted PERMANENTS with a 'Draconic' subtype. Draconic CHAIN LINKS are resolved attacks, not permanents -- nothing in play has that subtype, so the condition could not have been true.
The '...and "When this hits a hero, mark them"' half of the same sentence was missing entirely.

_comment: A duplicate of the mark ability was left behind when the corrected one was added: same trigger, same effect, gated on CONTROLS_TOKEN_TYPE 'Draconic', which nothing in the DB has as a slug or subtype. It could not fire, but it was one gate-fix away from marking twice.
